'''''Epilobium brachycarpum''''' is a species of [[Epilobium|willowherb]] known by the common names '''tall willowherb, tall annual willowherb, panicled willowherb''' and '''tall fireweed'''. It is native to North America, including Canada from Quebec to British Columbia, the western United States and the Dakotas, and southwestern and Central Mexico.<ref name="POWO" /> It is a resident of varied open and woodland habitats. It has also been [[introduced species|introduced]] to some areas in South America. This is a tall glandular, hairy annual herb occasionally reaching {{convert|2|m}} in height. It is somewhat gangly and thin like an erect weed, with narrow, curving, pointed leaves up to a few centimetres in length. The flower has four petals which may be so deeply notched that they look like four pairs. They are generally light purple or pink, with darker veining. The fruit is a capsule {{convert|1 to 3|cm}} long.
